name: jewel-tag
description: A gold bangle close-up (haldi ring) with a laser-etched HUID plate, and below it a paper bill whose last row carries the same code. A blue-ballpoint line then links the etched code to the bill row and circles it. Params: huid = 6-char code (default 'AB12CD'), item = bill row name, amount = bill row amount (number, Indian grouping), matchAt = seconds after the cut the pen line draws (default 0.9), x/y = top-left, width (default 860). Bangle and bill are tossed in on the cut frame; only the pen marks draw later.
